method: LIVE jev-route calls (paid TypeSafe tier), each answer labelled with what actually happened over the next FORWARD days
verdict: NOT CALIBRATED: probabilities must not be used raw — apply a mapping
limitations: The label is direction-of-next-30-days, not a trading P&L. This measures whether the judge's probabilities mean what they say, not whether trading on them profits.
Only 10 symbols and a single forward horizon are tested; a different horizon or universe could calibrate differently.
The model is jev-1.14 via the paid tier; the free tier is unreachable from this network (HTTP 403), so a free-tier calibration is not measured here.
No out-of-sample claim: the same router and the same data are used to ask and to label.
